title: 第5章 再摸我，就嫁给你！

第0005章 再摸我，就嫁给你！

“对了乘风，这是给你的车子，就停在楼下，军绿色。”

云老打断了叶乘风的思路，拿出一把老旧的车钥匙道。

叶乘风探头往下一看，赫然发现了一部掉漆严重，且车身早已被撞得坑坑洼洼的皮卡车，烂得不能再烂。

于是，叶乘风的嘴角抽搐得厉害，差点当场暴走。

“别生气哈，这也是为了配合你的新身份嘛。”

云老哈哈笑道：“要不然，以你这些年对国家的贡献，别说是豪车了，就是私人飞机也能配给你，但你见过开着私人飞机与豪车上班的普通保安吗？到时候你一过去，别有用心这几个字都写在脸上了。”

叶乘风笑骂道：“二手轿车再怎么不堪也比烂皮卡好吧？我才不开这破烂玩意儿，倒不如当个无车族更符合新身份。”

云老脸上的笑意，忽然显得戏谑起来：“沪城这些年，变化可是极大的，没有交通工具恐怕寸步难行。”

“那我就打的，甚至挤公车都比开那烂皮卡有面子！”

叶乘风直接把钥匙丢回给云老，意气风发地转身：“我就不信，无车族难道还不要过日子了！要是开那烂皮卡，妹子们都要被吓跑了，老子还没结婚呢。”

“也好，那我就……祝你成功吧。”

云老笑了笑，不忘提醒了一句：“记得早些出发哦，京城到沪城上千公里，挺远的。”

叶乘风头也不回地说道：“咖啡别喝太多，晚上不要熬夜啊。”

说完这话，叶乘风“嘭”地一声关上了房门。

“嗯，谈好了，走吧，跟我出发去沪城。”

叶乘风努了努嘴，简单把云老这次的任务，与颜怡月讲了一遍，就伸手道：“车钥匙给我。”

尽管颜怡月早已决定，以后不给这家伙车钥匙了。

但是，真正到了叶乘风问她拿车钥匙的时候，她却不得不郁闷地交了出来，并随着叶乘风上了高速，直奔沪城而去。

不过，让颜怡月很快放心的是，叶乘风这回只是狂飙了两个小时，便说道：“小月月，你来开吧，我休息会儿。”

颜怡月点点头，心想一直让你这首长开车载我，怪有些不好意思的。

叶乘风翻了个白眼，勾了勾手道：“你先坐我腿上，回头握住方向，我再把油门交给你就行了。”

颜怡月的俏脸，忽然又有些发红了。

要她坐在叶乘风的腿上，这得让她多难为情？

“快点啊！这段路正好都是直的，后面弯道才不好换位，车速那么快容易出事儿。”

颜怡月虽然百般不愿，但最终还是忍着心底的羞涩，小心翼翼地从副驾位转移到主驾位，一屁股坐在了叶乘风的腿上。

叶乘风提醒了一句，便把方向交给了她。

不过，让颜怡月脸色更红的是，叶乘风居然还没有动身去副驾位的意思，这让她别提有多尴尬了。

此时此刻，她与叶乘风的姿势，要多暧昧就有多么地暧昧。

于是，怀着羞赧的心情，颜怡月怯怯道：“叶……叶首长，您怎么还不挪位置？”

“你一直用屁股压着我，让我怎挪？”

他之所以不动，是因为一直在等着颜怡月稍稍抬起翘臀，那样他才能抽身。

颜怡月这才发现状况，于是一张俏脸直接红得好似渗血，心跳如同擂鼓。

下意识地，颜怡月赶紧拱起翘臀，好让叶乘风抽身离开。

“行了，你就别不好意思的了，又不是没摸过你屁股。”

叶乘风大大咧咧，说着竟又在她那浑圆翘臀抓了一把，这才挪到了副驾驶位。

颜怡月坐下后，一边开车一边嗔道：“你以后……以后要是再摸我屁股，我就……我就……我就……”

说到这里，颜怡月竟然不知道该怎么说下去了。

每次叶乘风摸她屁股，她都会说这么一句，但好像根本起不到效果！

叶乘风嘿嘿大笑，放倒座椅就睡了下来。

颜怡月鼓起勇气，恶狠狠说了一句。

叶乘风嘴角抽了抽，一时竟不知道怎么回她了。

不知不觉，新路虎揽胜驶入了沪城一家五星级酒店。

颜怡月开了一个房间后，便对叶乘风道：“首长，您先在酒店休息一晚，明天等您上班回来，我应该已经帮您找好住的房子了。”

“叫我叶大哥，或者乘风大哥吧。”

叶乘风苦笑了一声：“在公众场合，就不要这般首长首长的称呼了。还有，以后出来见我，只能穿便装。”

叶乘风摆了摆手，便独自去了房间。

舒舒服服地冲了个热水澡后，叶乘风换上了一套干爽衣服，然后盘坐在床上修炼了起来。

如今的地球，灵气十分稀薄，叶乘风足足修炼了四五个小时，才感觉丹田灵力增加了一点点。

于是，他很不满，干脆从储物戒指中取出了一口青铜炼丹炉，还有云老给的那株阳元草，以及其他数十种珍贵药材，打算炼制那修炼用的阳元丹。

修真近十年来，叶乘风所积攒下来的修真资源，其实除了这枚费了好大劲才收集到材料并炼制成功，且空间不足十立方米的储物戒指之外，就只有那口看上去不知道什么年份的青铜炼丹炉了。

至于其他灵草灵药，都被他修炼消耗掉了，剩下的则是一些零碎散乱的低档炼器材料。

“真的是一穷二白啊！要是在前辈的修真大陆，老子早就踏上飞剑，自由翱翔了。”

他的修真传承，来自一位意外降临地球的前辈，那个前辈就是修真大陆的人。

透过那位前辈临终前的庞大记忆，身为地球人的叶乘风虽然没有去过修真大陆，但却好似去过一般，十分的了解修真大陆环境。

跟地球上的稀薄灵气相比，修真大陆要完爆地球。

同时修真资源，也丰厚得很，像阳元草这种低阶灵草，随便一座深山都能采到几株。

“算了，还是老老实实炼丹修炼吧，不想那些有的没的了。”

叶乘风叹了口气，掌心忽地乍现出一团跳动的赤红火焰。

Chapter 0005 If you touch me again, I will marry you!

"By the way, Chengfeng, this is the car for you. It's parked downstairs. It's military green."

Mr. Yun interrupted Ye Chengfeng's thoughts, took out an old car key and said.

Ye Chengfeng looked down and suddenly found a pickup truck with serious paint peeling off and the body of the truck had been bumped into holes. It was extremely rotten.

As a result, the corners of Ye Chengfeng's mouth twitched so much that he almost ran away on the spot.

"Don't be angry, this is to suit your new identity."

Mr. Yun laughed and said, "Otherwise, based on your contribution to the country over the years, not to mention luxury cars, even private jets can be allocated to you. But have you ever seen ordinary security guards driving private jets and luxury cars to work? When you pass by, the words "ulterior motives" will be written on your face. "

Ye Chengfeng laughed and scolded: "No matter how bad a second-hand car is, it's still better than a bad pickup truck, right? I don't want to drive this junk thing. It's better to be a carless person, which is more in line with my new identity."

The smile on Mr. Yun's face suddenly became playful: "Shanghai has changed a lot in recent years. It would be difficult to move without transportation."

"Then I'll take a taxi. Even squeezing into the bus is more respectable than driving that crappy pickup truck!"

Ye Chengfeng threw the keys back to Mr. Yun and turned around with high spirits: "I don't believe it. People who don't have cars don't want to live anymore! If you drive that crappy pickup truck, the girls will be scared away. I'm not married yet."

"Okay, then I will... wish you success."

Mr. Yun smiled and did not forget to remind: "Remember to leave early. The distance from Beijing to Shanghai is thousands of kilometers, which is quite far."

Ye Chengfeng said without looking back: "Don't drink too much coffee and don't stay up late at night."

After saying this, Ye Chengfeng closed the door with a bang.

"Well, it's settled. Let's go, follow me to Shanghai."

Ye Chengfeng pursed his lips, briefly explained Mr. Yun's mission to Yan Yiyue, then stretched out his hand and said, "Give me the car keys."

Although Yan Yiyue had already decided not to give this guy car keys in the future.

However, when Ye Chengfeng actually asked her for the car keys, she had to hand them over depressedly, and followed Ye Chengfeng onto the highway and headed straight for Shanghai.

However, Yan Yiyue was quickly reassured that Ye Chengfeng only drove wildly for two hours this time, and then said: "Xiao Yueyue, you go ahead and drive, I will take a rest."

Yan Yiyue nodded, thinking that it would be a bit embarrassing to let you, the chief, drive me all the time.

Ye Chengfeng rolled his eyes, hooked his hands and said, "Just sit on my lap first, turn around and hold the steering wheel, and then I'll hand the accelerator to you."

Yan Yiyue's pretty face suddenly turned red again.

How embarrassing would it be for her to sit on Ye Chengfeng's lap?

"Hurry up! This section of the road happens to be straight. It's hard to change positions at the back curves. It's easy to get into trouble if the car is going so fast."

Although Yan Yiyue was reluctant in every possible way, she finally endured the shyness in her heart, carefully moved from the passenger seat to the main driver's seat, and sat down on Ye Chengfeng's lap.

Ye Chengfeng reminded her and gave her the direction.

However, what made Yan Yiyue's face turn even redder was that Ye Chengfeng actually had no intention of moving to the passenger seat, which made her extremely embarrassed.

At this moment, the posture between her and Ye Chengfeng was as ambiguous as possible.

So, with a shy mood, Yan Yiyue said timidly: "Ye... Chief Ye, why don't you move your position?"

"You keep pressing me with your butt, how can I move?"

The reason why he didn't move was because he had been waiting for Yan Yiyue to lift her hips slightly so that he could pull away.

Only then did Yan Yiyue realize the situation, so her pretty face turned red as if blood was oozing, and her heartbeat was like beating a drum.

Subconsciously, Yan Yiyue quickly raised her hips to let Ye Chengfeng pull away.

"Okay, don't be embarrassed. It's not like I haven't touched your butt."

Ye Chengfeng was so carefree that he grabbed her round butt again before moving to the passenger seat.

After Yan Yiyue sat down, she said angrily while driving: "If you... touch my butt again, I will... I will... I will..."

At this point, Yan Yiyue didn't know what to say anymore.

Every time Ye Chengfeng touched her butt, she would say this, but it seemed to have no effect at all!

Ye Chengfeng laughed, put down the seat and fell asleep.

Yan Yiyue mustered up her courage and said something fiercely.

The corners of Ye Chengfeng's mouth twitched, and for a moment he didn't know how to reply to her.

Unknowingly, the new Range Rover drove into a five-star hotel in Shanghai.

After Yan Yiyue opened a room, she said to Ye Chengfeng: "Chief, please rest in the hotel for one night. When you come back from work tomorrow, I should have found a house for you."

"Call me Brother Ye, or Brother Chengfeng."

Ye Chengfeng smiled bitterly: "In public places, you don't want to be called the leader. Also, when you come out to see me in the future, you can only wear casual clothes."

Ye Chengfeng waved his hand and went to the room alone.

After taking a comfortable hot shower, Ye Chengfeng changed into a set of dry clothes, then sat cross-legged on the bed and started practicing.

Today's earth, spiritual energy is very thin. Ye Chengfeng practiced for four or five hours before he felt that the spiritual energy in his Dantian increased a little.

So, he was very dissatisfied and simply took out a bronze alchemy furnace from the storage ring, as well as the Yang Yuan grass given by Mr. Yun, and dozens of other precious medicinal materials, intending to refine the Yang Yuan Dan for cultivation.

In fact, the cultivation resources that Ye Chengfeng had accumulated in the past ten years, apart from the storage ring that he had taken a lot of effort to collect materials and successfully refined, and which had less than ten cubic meters of space, were the only bronze alchemy furnace that looked to be of unknown age.

As for the other spiritual herbs and elixirs, they were all consumed by his cultivation, and what was left were some scattered low-end weapon refining materials.

"I'm really broke! If I were in the cultivation continent of my predecessors, I would have stepped on the flying sword and soared freely."

His cultivation inheritance came from a senior who unexpectedly came to Earth, and that senior was from the Cultivation Continent.

Through the vast memory of the senior before his death, although Ye Chengfeng, an earthling, has never been to the Cultivation Continent, he seems to have been there and understands the environment of the Cultivation Continent very well.

Compared with the thin spiritual energy on the earth, the Cultivation Continent will completely explode the earth.

At the same time, cultivation resources are also very abundant. You can pick a few low-level spiritual grasses like Yang Yuan grass in any deep mountain.

"Forget it, let's just keep practicing alchemy. I don't want to lose what I have."

Ye Chengfeng sighed, and a ball of beating red flame suddenly appeared in his palm.
